0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 5th in the Southeast and 3 games back) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, 5th in the Northwest and 7 games back), with Orlando on a one-game winning streak and Utah on a nine-game losing streak. Orlando is 3-3 on the road and 0-4 at home, Utah is 1-5 at home and 0-5 on the road, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 120-117 win in Orlando on February 7, 2026. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), with Tristan da Silva day-to-day after a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), with Keyonte George day-to-day after an ankle sprain and a game-time decision.
